description: docker.yml metadata-action tag: 'type=raw,value=latest,enable=${{ github.ref == refs/heads/main }}' — this pushes :latest on every main commit, not only semver releases. For a server binary this means :latest tracks the tip of main which may be pre-release. Standard practice is :latest only on versioned tag. P3 ops.
title: Dockerfile: latest tag emitted on every push to main (not just semver)
